purpose: Merged piano8 kernel candidate: native display, display PM, WN8030 keyboard and charging3; offline qualification does not establish combined hardware support.
note: 'config' is the base fragment read by tools/build-kernel.sh; the installed release merges the remaining release_config_fragments in that order via CONFIG_FRAGMENT_EXTRA (space separated). piano-release.config is last and sets the unique release 7.2.6-piano<ABI>; kernel/abi.json records which commit and .config each packaged release was built from.
